register.labelZh: BASH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: bash away 表示某人持續努力做事;bash on 則表示某人繼續做下去,通常是在停頓或遇到困難之後。；bash down、bash in 和 bash about 可以分別表達把某物撞倒、把某物撞凹或打破,以及把某物粗暴地撞來撞去。；bash out 可以表示某人迅速而直接地寫出、做出或演奏出某物。；bash somebody up 和 bash somebody about 常見於談論打鬥或襲擊的對話、故事和報道;其他BASH 表達亦可用來談論工作、損壞和迅速完成事情。
register.summaryEn: Bash away shows that someone keeps working hard. Bash on shows that someone continues, often after a pause or difficulty. Bash down, bash in and bash about help you distinguish between knocking something over, denting or breaking it inwards, and knocking it around roughly. Bash out is useful when someone writes, makes or plays something quickly and directly. Bash somebody up and bash somebody about often appear in conversations, stories and reports about fights or attacks. The other BASH expressions are also useful for work, damage and quick production.
